themeBehavior.invalidOrUnavailableStorage: Use night; storage writes are optional and caught.

night.architecture: Static observatory aperture, ribs and restrained amber edges

hangar.architecture: Blue-steel bay door leaves, diagonal braces and warm work lights

rendering.assets: Architecture is Three.js geometry; floor seams and linear HDR reflection maps are procedural DataTextures. PMREM is prepared when supported. No new shipping raster asset.
rendering.limitations: Source-derived rendering parameters are not optical calibration, device-wide visual guarantees or hardware safety evidence.

provenance.status: Source extraction and recorded captures; finish-review verdict is owned by the separate review report.

extensions.previewNotes: Each multi snippet carries locally scoped source-derived theme variables and both theme previews, so it works without the application stylesheet or a framework runtime. Preview values are static. Tonal ramps are synthesized metadata, not additional shipping palette tokens.

narrative.overview:
The multi-robot route (`/multi/`) presents real robot finishes and working manipulation inside a grounded, illuminated orbital laboratory. 深空指挥舱 is the default: graphite-blue structure, a static observatory aperture, neutral-white overhead pools and mint controls. 轨道机库 is its companion: blue-steel bay doors, structural braces, warmer work-light details and champagne controls. Both preserve the approved depth and clear shell lighting; the owner rejected the overly white 极昼实验室.

This is a scoped merge of the built multi-robot design and the incumbent system. `/Rebot_Arm_AGV/`, `/r1/`, `/g1/` and `/c5/` retain the supplied dark-blue/cyan reference appearance. Tokens prefixed `multi-` apply only to `/multi/`; `legacy-` tokens preserve the independent reference workcells. Object swatches are shared by the two multi scenes and describe task choices. The route-specific composition and direction decision live in `work/MULTI-SURFACE-BRIEF.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Clearly lit robot shells against graphite and steel-blue architecture.
Compact, Chinese-labeled native controls with visible selected and focus states.
One in-place scene choice changes the set, floor, light and interface together.
Independent reference workcells keep their existing visual identity.

rules.name: The Route Scope Rule
rules.body: Apply each token family only to its named routes; this document does not recolor the independent workcells.

rules.name: The Object Meaning Rule
rules.body: Theme changes must preserve red/blue/yellow object meaning and written labels. Scene accents never replace robot finishes or task colors.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for counts, progress, angles and measured output. Keep source units and state honest: radians/degrees, N, N·m and mm stay attached to the corresponding values; unavailable measurements display a placeholder rather than fabricated telemetry.

rules.name: The Shell Legibility Rule
rules.body: Reveal original robot materials with light and reflection; do not repaint the robot with an emissive theme color.

rules.name: The In-Place Scene Rule
rules.body: Scene choice is presentation only: it changes the environment, floor, lighting, interface and chart palette without resetting an executing task, moving the robots or replacing the current camera view. Remember a valid choice when browser storage is available; unavailable or invalid storage falls back to 深空指挥舱.

dos: Do apply the two orbital laboratory palettes only to `/multi/` and preserve the independent reference routes.
Do keep neutral overhead lighting, readable original robot finishes and grounded worktables in both multi scenes.
Do pair task colors, status colors and scene selection with written labels and exposed native states.
Do preserve keyboard focus, native form behavior, reduced-motion handling and reachable scene choices at phone widths.
Do keep blank-space camera gestures separate from object editing and scene switching separate from task state.
Do keep measurements tied to real simulation output and distinguish software evidence from hardware behavior.
donts: Don't reintroduce the rejected white 极昼实验室 as the companion to 深空指挥舱.
Don't recolor robot meshes, task objects or independent workcells with the scene accent.
Don't add invented telemetry, fake live-feed imagery or decorative perpetual motion.
Don't reset tasks, alter robot placement or replace the current view when switching scenes.
Don't infer visual, touch, optical or real-robot approval from numerical simulation tests.
Don't approximate supplied robot silhouettes or replace G1 Dex1 with photographed five-finger hands.
